Questions

Does this work in Excel too? +

It's built for Google Sheets. It may open in Excel, but dropdowns, conditional formatting and some formulas are tuned for Sheets and aren't guaranteed to carry over cleanly.

How do I install it? +

After purchase you'll get a link — make a copy into your own Google Drive with one click and start logging.

Can I track manga, manhwa and manhua together? +

Yes — the Type column covers manga, manhwa, manhua, webtoon and other, so one tracker handles everything you read.

Is it really pay-what-you-want? +

Yes — enter any amount you're comfortable paying above the minimum and check out instantly.
